title: ContestTemplate
description: A portable, reusable contest ruleset: exchange fields, scoring, and multiplier rules. Contains no dates — see event.schema.json for a specific year's dated occurrence of a template.

short.description: Short label for compact UI (badges, dropdowns).

description.description: One or two sentences summarizing exchange + scoring, shown in the template picker.

sentHint.description: Reminder of what the logging station sends, shown on the entry form.

multLabel.description: Label for the multiplier count, e.g. "ARRL/RAC sections".

regionSet.description: Which map the dashboard draws. 'arrl_sections'/'us_ca'/'world' reuse the receiving app's built-in geographic TopoJSON. 'custom' renders a worked/needed chip grid from the multiplier's own region list instead — use this for any region set the receiving app can't be assumed to have pre-built map geometry for (state/county QSO parties, etc.). 'none' hides the map entirely.

dupe.description: Whether a station may be worked once for the whole contest, or once per band.

defaultFields.description: Which optional contact-form fields are shown by default.

regions.description: For kind: 'region' — the full list of valid/suggested codes. Also what the 'location' and 'region_list' multiplier kinds score against, via multiplier.field.

strict.description: For kind: 'region' — reject anything that isn't exactly one of 'regions' (case-insensitive). Only for closed lists with no escape hatch; a field that also accepts "DX" or similar must leave this unset.

default.description: Default value for a fresh QSO, e.g. RST 59.

oneOf.description: Built-in: scores against the app's own ARRL/RAC section list.

field.description: Name of an exchange field with kind:'region' — its own 'regions' array is what gets scored.

oneOf.description: Generic closed-list multiplier: exact match against the named exchange field's own 'regions'. Use this for any new state/county-style QSO party template — no app code change required to add one.

field.description: Name of an exchange field with kind:'region'. A region with a 'parent' rolls up to that parent (e.g. a county counting as its state).

naOnly.description: DX fallback only counts North American DXCC entities.

dxCounts.description: A value not found in 'regions' falls back to the DXCC entity of the callsign.

oneOf.description: Two-tier location multiplier (NEQP/NAQP-style): county→state rollup, plus an optional DX/DXCC fallback for anything outside the list.

lowBandFactor.description: Multiplies points on 160/80/40m, e.g. CQ WPX's doubling.
